requirements.controllingText: Every registered operation declares named input ports, output ports, exact types, cardinalities, deterministic error codes, error propagation, and resource-cost category. Each operation declares exact input arity and types and one normalized output type. Multi-artifact branches use explicit step references. BYTE_COMPARE and COMPARE receive explicit left and right inputs. Assertions receive explicit actual and expected inputs. A failed or unknown predecessor prevents dependent execution and propagates the registered terminal disposition without partial canonical result; errors propagate as typed execution failure and no later step may consume a failed output. Intermediate step outputs exist only for the current execution unless explicitly emitted as observations or evidence.

Export or share and any delivery completion are separately receipted and never inferred from authorization. Stage 30 closes through the one atomic CALCULATE_TERMINAL command, which reads the precondition revision, validates registry integrity and all terminal prerequisites, creates exactly one current terminal determination, sets DELIVERY_STATE = AUTHORIZED only when every prerequisite is true and otherwise BLOCKED, increments revision once, and commits once. The command's own committed revision does not invalidate its result; only a later revision affecting its dependency closure may supersede or withdraw it. Registry incompleteness blocks Stage 30 unless it proves an earlier premise false; it does not create a Stage 27↔Stage 30 cycle.

requirements.controllingText: Because the canonical handoff container is logical under Section 19.7, per-member sequential export or share on the pinned device satisfies package export whenever a combined multi-file share is unavailable; the optional archive representation is never required. Before the acceptance run, the acceptance procedure executes a recorded MOBILE_CAPABILITY_PROBE on the pinned target covering file export or share, response-file selection, returned-file slot selection, persistent-storage request, logical package export, and backup export and restore. A required capability the pinned target cannot perform yields BLOCKED with the exact missing capability recorded. The only permitted continuations are a new pinned target record on an iOS or Safari version that supports the capability, or a governance change to the controlling specification. No silent degradation path exists.
